# NailIQ

NailIQ is an AI-first operating system for nail salons and beauty businesses.

Core capabilities:
- AI booking system
- Salon website builder
- Staff scheduling
- POS and checkout modules
- CRM
- AI menu scanner
- AI nail try-on
- AI receptionist
- Automation engine
- Analytics and growth dashboard
- Viral referral system

Primary users:
- Nail salon owners
- Beauty business owners
- Salon staff
